title: Advanced AI & LLM Engineering — From Python Foundations to Production AI Systems
summary: One path in 17 stages: Python and math, classical ML and deep learning, NLP and transformers, LLMs from scratch and alignment, vision, speech, multimodal, LLM applications and agents, evaluation, and production systems.

stages.title: Python Foundations & Software Engineering
stages.outcome: Set up a reproducible Python workspace, package and test Python code, configure a run, use Git and the shell, and manage project data.

stages.title: Backend & API Engineering
stages.outcome: Handle API keys safely, provision GPU and cloud environments, and package work in containers. Building and testing HTTP services is not yet covered by a lesson.

stages.title: Mathematics & Statistics
stages.outcome: Build the linear algebra, calculus, probability, statistics, optimization, and signal math that machine learning uses.

stages.title: Classical Machine Learning
stages.outcome: Implement and evaluate regression, trees, SVMs, ensembles, and unsupervised methods, then design an ML system end to end.

stages.title: Deep Learning
stages.outcome: Build a neural network and a small framework from scratch, move to PyTorch, and train and debug CNN image classifiers.

stages.title: NLP & Text Processing
stages.outcome: Process text, learn word and subword representations, and build sequence models up to attention, retrieval, and question answering.

stages.title: Transformers & Attention
stages.outcome: Derive and implement self-attention, multi-head attention, the full transformer, and the BERT, GPT, and encoder-decoder families.

stages.title: LLMs from Scratch
stages.outcome: Build a tokenizer and data pipeline, assemble and train a GPT in PyTorch, and load pretrained weights.

stages.title: LLM Fine-Tuning & Alignment
stages.outcome: Fine-tune with SFT, LoRA, RLHF, and DPO, study the alignment failure modes, then evaluate and quantize the result.

stages.title: Computer Vision
stages.outcome: Cover detection, segmentation, self-supervised and open-vocabulary vision, generative image models, OCR, and edge deployment.

stages.title: Speech & Audio AI
stages.outcome: Work with audio features, speech recognition, Whisper, speaker models, text-to-speech, real-time audio, and neural codecs.

stages.title: Multimodal AI
stages.outcome: Connect vision and audio encoders to language models with CLIP, Q-Formers, LLaVA-style projection, and cross-attention, then evaluate them.

stages.title: LLM Application Engineering
stages.outcome: Build prompts, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, MCP clients and servers, and a production LLM application.

stages.title: AI Agents & Agentic Systems
stages.outcome: Build the agent loop, planning, reflection, memory, graph orchestration, voice agents, autonomy controls, and multi-agent coordination.

stages.title: Evaluation, Reliability & Observability
stages.outcome: Measure RAG, model, and agent quality with harnesses, traces, failure taxonomies, benchmarks, verification gates, and adversarial testing.

stages.title: Production AI Engineering & Infrastructure
stages.outcome: Serve, route, scale, deploy, monitor, secure, and cost-control LLM systems, including MCP security and ML monitoring.

stages.title: Advanced Integration Projects
stages.outcome: Combine the path into complete systems: an LLM pipeline, an end-to-end RAG system, an observability dashboard, a production RAG chatbot, and a fine-tuning pipeline.
